festival.welcome: Welcome to the Mwanga Festival and Marathon
festival.intro1: A vibrant celebration of our beautiful district nestled within the heart of the Kilimanjaro region. This unique event is more than just a race; it's a testament to our community's spirit and a showcase of Mwanga's hidden gems.
festival.intro2: Born from a desire to share the rich culture and stunning landscapes of our home, the festival and marathon aim to boost internal tourism, inviting Tanzanians from across the nation to experience the warmth and wonder of Mwanga.
festival.communityText: The event is proudly organized by <link>Kisangara Tours Ltd</link>, a Tanzania-based tour operator, in collaboration with <org>Mberesero Group</org>, <org>Osaka Royal Classic</org>, <org>Mwanga District Office</org>, and <org>Mwanga Community</org> members, fostering a sense of unity and pride.
festival.invitationText: Join us as we celebrate our heritage, embrace the breathtaking scenery, and stride towards a brighter future for Mwanga.
festival.regionalFocusText: Centered within the Mwanga district of the Kilimanjaro region, with a strong local emphasis on promoting internal tourism and health supports to mothers and children.
festival.organizationText: The event is proudly organized by <link>Kisangara Tours Ltd</link>, a Tanzania-based tour operator, in collaboration with <org>Mberesero Group</org>, <org>Osaka Royal Classic</org>, <org>Mwanga District Office</org>, and <org>Mwanga Community</org> members.
festival.purposeText: More than a race: Mwanga Marathon uses sport to bring tourism, culture, conservation, education and community development together, so people discover Tanzania's attractions and learn how tourism can benefit their community.
festival.distinctionText: This event is distinct from the well-known Kilimanjaro Marathon in Mwanga District. The Mwanga Festival and Marathon is a separate, localized event.

purpose.missionText: To use sport and entertainment to reach more Tanzanians and visitors, building awareness of the value of Tanzanian tourism, protecting the environment and cultural heritage, and opening up tourism jobs and business for the people of Mwanga.
purpose.visionText: That everyone who comes to Mwanga for the marathon finds reasons to stay longer — to visit its attractions, learn its culture and do business with the community — and that the festival grows into a fixture of Tanzania's tourism, sports and culture calendar.

cta.title: Ready to Join the Marathon?
cta.text: Be part of this extraordinary event celebrating sports, culture, and community. Register now to secure your spot in the Mwanga Festival & Marathon!

sponsors.weAreProudTo: We are proud to partner with these exceptional organizations who share our vision for promoting sports and culture in Tanzania.
sponsors.proudSponsorOfMwafem: Proud sponsor of MWAFEM events, supporting our mission to promote sports and culture in Tanzania.
sponsors.joinOurGrowingFamily: Join our growing family of sponsors and be part of this extraordinary journey. Together, we can make a lasting impact on sports and culture in Tanzania.

programme.intro: Races are the heart of the day, but the festival brings tourism, culture, food and learning to C.D. Msuya Stadium too.
programme.slogan: “Tukijua Tanzania, tutaitembelea; tukiitembelea Tanzania, tutaithamini; tukiithamini, tutailinda.”
programme.sloganTranslation: When we know Tanzania, we will visit it; when we visit Tanzania, we will value it; when we value it, we will protect it.

items.title: Races
items.text: Half Marathon 21.1 km, Trail Run 10 km, Fun Run 5 km, and the 2.5 km Walking Safari / Fun Run for children and families.

items.title: Tug of war & traditional games
items.text: Tug of war in the stadium and traditional games for teams and families.

items.title: Culture
items.text: Traditional dress, dances and music, customs and community history.

items.title: Mwanga attractions
items.text: Photos, videos and guided walks showing the tourist attractions of Mwanga and Kilimanjaro.

items.title: Crafts & local products
items.text: Handicrafts and tourism products made by local artisans.

items.title: Traditional food
items.text: Tasting traditional dishes from different areas, prepared by local women and food entrepreneurs.

items.title: Tourism education
items.text: Talks on domestic tourism, sports and eco-tourism, and jobs and business in tourism.

items.title: Green Mwanga
items.text: Tree planting, clean-ups and lessons on protecting water sources and the climate.

items.title: Youth & children
items.text: Kids’ games, youth competitions, talent shows and environmental education in schools.

items.title: Business expo
items.text: Hotels, tour guides, transport, artisans and investors showing their services and products.

items.title: Arts & entertainment
items.text: Art, talent and traditional entertainment throughout the day.

package: Participation medal — plus medals and prizes for the winners

community.title: Tree planting
community.text: Planting trees at schools and health centres to prevent soil erosion.

community.title: Mothers and newborns
community.text: Visiting maternity wards with diapers and sanitary pads, supporting essential child vaccinations and training young mothers.

community.title: Promoting Mwanga
community.text: Visiting and promoting Mwanga’s tourist attractions, ending with an environmental seminar.
